scope: Native Slate front end: title, pause, settings (画面/操控/声音), controls guide, quit and display-keep dialogs (SNCFrontEnd.h/.cpp), plus the first-play tutorial overlay (SNCOnboarding.h/.cpp).
increments: 2026-10-22 onboarding: SNCOnboarding first-play tutorial (modal Welcome / Complete, small HUD card for Look, Walk, EnterCar, Drive, ExitCar); 启动时自动无边框 toggle; 试听当前音量 audio preview; 重新体验新手引导 / 跳过引导 on the controls guide.

identity.brand: NEON COAST (Latin wordmark, Bold, letter spacing 180) with 霓虹海岸 as a teal eyebrow above it. This is an original title, with no third-party marks, fonts or layouts.
identity.tone: Restrained, warm, cinematic. The live paused street scene is the hero image. The UI shades it and does not replace it: no logos, textures, gradients from image files, or neon glow on the interface.
identity.language: All labels are Chinese. Key names (Enter, Esc, Tab, LB/RB, A/B/X/Y, LT/RT, L3) stay Latin, as players see them on their hardware.

palette_srgb.ink: #101D28, panels at 0.90 and dialogs at 0.98 alpha. Same value as ANCHUD::Ink.
palette_srgb.cream: #FFF2D6 for primary text and the focus plate
palette_srgb.sand: #D9CDB5 for secondary text, descriptions and hints
palette_srgb.mist: #9CAEAC for tertiary text, column labels and inactive tabs
palette_srgb.teal: #5FD8C0 for focus edges, active tab underline, values of the focused row, gamepad key caps and primary actions
palette_srgb.amber: #FFC457 for attention: the pause eyebrow, panel rule, unsaved dots, unsaved status and the display countdown
palette_srgb.coral: #FF8A6E, used only for an apply failure

backdrop.method: Painted in SNCFrontEnd::OnPaint with three Slate gradients. There is no image asset.
backdrop.side_scrim: Left to right. Title and pause use deep ink at 0.88 / 0.70 / 0.20 / 0.04 at x = 0 / 30 / 60 / 100%, so the street and car stay clear on the right. Settings and controls use 0.94 / 0.86 / 0.58 / 0.42 so the panel reads first.
backdrop.top_haze: 0.50 at the top edge, fading to 0 at 16% height.
backdrop.floor: 0 at 58% height, rising to 0.74 at the bottom edge, so the footer key hints sit on dark.

layout_reference.units: Slate units at a 1920x1080 reference. The engine's default DPI curve (shortest side) scales the whole tree, so 1280x720 is 0.667x and 1600x900 is 0.833x with identical composition. Panel widths fit 16:9 and 16:10.
layout_reference.left_margin: 120-132 units for every page, so text never moves when switching pages.
layout_reference.root: Column 540 wide, vertically centred: eyebrow 22, wordmark, 72x3 amber rule, tagline 21, menu buttons 58 high with 6 gaps, optional 当前进度 card from GetFrontEndProgressText.
layout_reference.wordmark: Correction after native 1600x900 capture (single-line 86 overran the 540 column and showed NEON CO…): the title stacks NEON / COAST as two Bold 80 lines with letter spacing 180 (COAST is about 400 wide), with the second line pulled up 22 units into the first line's descent so the two read as one mark. Pause keeps a single NEON COAST line at 46 (about 460 wide). Both fit the 540 column at every 16:9 size because the whole tree scales from the 1920x1080 reference.
layout_reference.progress_card: Correction: the controller string 'label value · label value · …' is split on '·' and shown as a stat strip: each item is a mist label (Regular 16) over a cream value (Bold 22), auto-width with 36 gaps, so 发现 0/8 never wraps alone. If the string is not 2-4 'label value' items it falls back to the plain wrapped text. No controller change.
layout_reference.settings_panel: 1040 wide, 64 from the top and 96 from the bottom, radius 6, padding 48/36. Contents: amber rule + eyebrow, title 42, hairline, tab strip [LB] 画面 操控 声音 [RB], rows 60 high with 6 gaps (label left, 440-wide control right), a description box for the focused row, then a footer with status on the left and 恢复默认 / 返回 / 应用 on the right.
layout_reference.controls_panel: 1180 wide, with two sections per band (步行 | 驾驶, 通用 | 其他). Each line is action / keyboard cap / gamepad cap at 34 high, followed by a teal camera-direction note. Footer: 重新体验新手引导, 跳过引导 (only while a tutorial is active), a mist 17 tip 游戏中按 F2 跳过引导 filling the middle, then 调整操控设置 / 返回 on the right. No extra rows, so the panel height is unchanged.
layout_reference.video_tab: Six rows now: 显示模式, 分辨率, 画面质量, 帧率上限, 垂直同步, 启动时自动无边框 (new, last so existing order and pad paths are unchanged). 6 x (60 + 6 gap) = 396 units, inside the roughly 478 the settings panel leaves for the tab body at 1080.
layout_reference.audio_tab: Three sliders, then the 试听当前音量 action row: the control shows the APPLIED levels (已应用 · 主 80% · 音效 100%) and a 试听 pill (teal 0.16, solid teal with ink text when focused). Both read mist when the applied master or effects volume is 0 (主音量或音效为 0).
layout_reference.dialogs: 660-wide card centred over a deep-ink 0.62 dim: accent rule + eyebrow, title 34, body 20, buttons bottom-right. The display dialog adds an amber countdown line and a draining bar.
layout_reference.footer_hints: Bottom-right, 34 from the edge. Key caps are outlined (keyboard cream, gamepad teal), with the action in sand at 17.

typography.source: FCoreStyle default font (Roboto plus the engine CJK fallback). There is no font asset. The Bold/Regular faces carry the hierarchy, and letter spacing is used only on Latin and eyebrows.
typography.scale: 80 two-line title wordmark / 46 pause wordmark,42 page title, 34 dialog title, 25 menu item, 22 row label/value, 21 tab, 20 button/body, 19 description, 17-18 hints/status, 14-16 eyebrows/column labels. The 14-unit minimum is about 9.3 px at 720p, used only for Latin-heavy column labels. Chinese body text is never below 17 (11.3 px at 720p).

interaction_states.focus_language: One state everywhere. The focused item gets a cream plate (0.96) with ink text and a teal edge (4-unit bar on menu items, 3-unit bar on rows, underline on tabs). Pressed flashes teal. The engine's dashed focus rectangle is suppressed by overriding GetFocusBrush to null on the subclassed SButton, SCheckBox and SSlider.
interaction_states.hover: A real mouse move over an item moves focus to it (EFocusCause::Mouse), so mouse and pad never show two highlighted items. Moves with zero cursor delta are ignored, so a stationary cursor cannot steal the default focus when a page is rebuilt.
interaction_states.rows: The focused row background rises from cream 0.025 to 0.09, the label goes from sand to cream and the value turns teal. An amber 8-unit dot marks a row that changed but is not applied.
interaction_states.tabs: Active tab: cream text with a teal underline. Inactive tab: mist. Keyboard or pad focus moving onto a tab selects it (deferred one tick). Mouse hover does not.
interaction_states.disabled: The resolution row is disabled in borderless mode and shows 跟随桌面 · W × H. It is skipped by navigation.

input_model.ownership: The widget handles every key, analog, mouse button and wheel event that its children do not use, and returns Handled. Nothing bubbles to the game viewport.
input_model.arrows_dpad: The focused control turns these into a navigation request (SWidget::OnKeyDown). SNCFrontEnd::OnNavigation then resolves them on an explicit row/column grid: head (tabs), body (option rows), tail (footer buttons), or the dialog row. The root menu wraps vertically and settings does not. Arriving at the tab row lands on the active tab. Arriving at the settings footer lands on 应用. Each arrow is handled exactly once.
input_model.left_stick: FSlateApplication::GetNavigationDirectionFromAnalog provides Slate's thresholds and hold-to-repeat. The right stick is consumed.
input_model.left_right_on_rows: Choice rows step their value, sliders step by StepSize (RequiresControllerLock off), and toggles flip.
input_model.accept: Enter, Space or A on the focused SButton/SCheckBox. Clicking a toggle row's label also flips it.
input_model.back: Esc, B or Virtual_Back call HandleBack, ignoring key repeats. Title opens quit_confirm. Pause resumes. Settings discards the draft and returns. Controls returns. quit_confirm cancels. video_confirm reverts.
input_model.start: On title or pause, Start calls StartOrResumeGame. In settings and controls it acts as back. In video_confirm it is ignored.
input_model.tabs: LB/RB, PageUp/PageDown and Tab/Shift+Tab cycle tabs. Focus stays on the tab strip if it was there, otherwise it goes to the first row.
input_model.focus_guarantees: Every page or dialog change requests focus on its first action, and the request is re-applied each tick until accepted. Returning from a sub page refocuses the root button that opened it. Closing a dialog refocuses what was focused before it opened. If focus falls to the SViewport or SWindow while the app is active and IsFrontEndOpen(), the last focused item is restored. A click on empty space keeps the current selection.

settings_behaviour.draft: FNCSettingsDraft (header) holds every option. Original is captured from UNCGameUserSettings when settings opens. Browsing, cancelling and 恢复默认 only change the draft. 恢复默认 resets the current tab only. Video defaults are borderless, desktop resolution, 高 (High), 60 FPS and VSync on. Controls and audio defaults match the backend (1.0 / off / 0.15, and 1.0 / 0.6 / 1.0).
settings_behaviour.apply: All setters are called (SetFullscreenMode, SetScreenResolution, SetOverallScalabilityLevel only when the level changed, SetFrameRateLimit, SetVSyncEnabled, plus the custom input and volume setters), then ApplySettings(false), which applies input/audio and saves. Without a display change, ConfirmVideoMode and SaveSettings run immediately and the status reads 设置已应用并保存。
settings_behaviour.display_change: The previous mode and resolution are snapshotted and video_confirm opens with a 15 s FPlatformTime wall-clock deadline, checked in Tick so it expires while the world is paused. 保留设置 calls ConfirmVideoMode and SaveSettings. 恢复, Esc/B, timeout, OpenRoot or widget destruction restore the snapshot, then call ApplyResolutionSettings(false), ConfirmVideoMode and SaveSettings. Other applied settings are kept. The default focus is 恢复, so a blind press on a broken display does not keep it.
settings_behaviour.crash_safety: Between Apply and Keep the ini holds the new FullscreenMode/Resolution and the old LastConfirmed* values. Startup can detect the mismatch and RevertVideoMode. That check belongs to the controller/backend.
settings_behaviour.resolution_list: 1280x720, 1600x900 and 1920x1080, minus any larger than the desktop, plus the desktop and current resolutions, sorted by area.
settings_behaviour.quality: 低 / 中 / 高 / 极高 = scalability 0-3. Level -1 or 4 shows 自定义 and is left untouched unless changed.
settings_behaviour.start_in_borderless: FNCSettingsDraft::bStartInBorderless (default true) is captured, reset by 恢复默认 on 画面, compared in VideoEquals and written with SetStartInBorderless on 应用. It is deliberately not in DisplayModeEquals: it only takes effect at the next launch, so changing it alone never opens the 15 s keep dialog.
settings_behaviour.audio_preview: Settings.AudioPreview calls ANCPlayerController::PreviewAudio(), which plays at the applied settings, never the draft. Status: 正在试听当前音量。 (teal) when nothing is unapplied, 试听的是已应用的音量。 (amber) when the audio draft is dirty, 主音量或音效为 0，无法试听。 (amber, no call) when muted, 暂时无法试听。 (coral) when PreviewAudio returns false. The row stays focusable when muted so the reason is always reachable.
settings_behaviour.feedback: The status line shows teal for applied or kept, amber for reverted, timed out or defaults set, and mist for nothing to apply. A persistent amber line reads 有未应用的更改 · 按“应用”保存 while the draft is dirty (the discard behaviour is in the 返回 hint). Correction: the status sits in the roughly 396 units left of the three 168-wide footer buttons, so every message is kept to one line of at most about 14 CJK characters at 18 (设置已应用并保存。 / 显示设置已保留并保存。 / 显示已恢复，其他更改仍保留。 / 未确认，已恢复原显示设置。 / 本页已恢复默认，按“应用”保存。 / 本页已经是默认值。 / 没有需要应用的更改。 / 无法读取设置，未作更改。). The text also wraps at a fixed 370, so a longer string breaks onto a second line instead of running under the buttons.

onboarding.source: SNCOnboarding (SCompoundWidget, OwnerController). All copy comes from UNCOnboardingComponent GetTitle / GetBody / GetKeys / GetExtraHint; the widget adds only eyebrows, button labels, the Welcome lesson chips and key hints.
onboarding.modal: Welcome and Complete. 640-wide ink 0.97 card (radius 6, padding 44/36) centred over a deep-ink 0.55 scrim: accent rule + eyebrow (新手引导 teal / 引导完成 amber) with a mist 'n / 7' counter, a 7-segment progress strip (72 x 4, gaps 6), title Bold 34, body Regular 20 sand wrapped at 552. Welcome shows 五个小练习 with five numbered pills (视角 步行 上车 驾驶 下车). Complete shows 接下来可以 and the component's key groups (E / 十字键右 接单互动, M / View 地图) as key-cap lines. Buttons bottom-right: Welcome 跳过引导 + 开始引导 (primary), Complete 开始探索 only. Hairline, then Enter A 确认 · ← → 选择 · Esc B 跳过/关闭.
onboarding.hud_card: Look, Walk, EnterCar, Drive, ExitCar. 380 wide, top-right at 36 from the right edge (the HUD margin) and 152 from the top, so it sits under the cash / wanted block and clear of the objective panel (top-left), minimap (bottom-left), vehicle / ammo readout (bottom-right) and the centre prompts. Ink 0.84 soft panel with a 3-unit teal left edge: 新手引导 eyebrow + n / 7, 7-segment strip (44 x 4, gaps 4) whose current segment fills with GetProgress, title Bold 22, live body Regular 17, one key-cap line per GetKeys group, live GetExtraHint in teal 17 (sampled every 0.2 s; hidden when it is the generic F2 line), hairline, F2 跳过引导 · Esc Menu 暂停. Roughly 260-340 tall at 1080, so it ends well above the bottom-right readout. The whole card is HitTestInvisible.
onboarding.key_groups: GetKeys is split on four spaces into groups and each group on '：'. Key text is split on '/' into caps: the first is a cream keyboard cap, the rest are teal gamepad caps with any 手柄 prefix removed. Groups without '：' fall back to plain wrapped text.
onboarding.progress: Segments before the current step are teal; the current one is a teal 0.28 track filled with GetProgress (full on modal steps); later ones are cream 0.12. Step counter uses GetStepIndex / GetStepCount.
onboarding.scaling: Same 1920x1080 reference as the front end, so the engine DPI curve keeps the composition from 1280x720 (0.667x: card about 253 px wide, body about 15 px) to 2560x1440 (1.333x). Chinese text in the card is never below 17, in the modal never below 18 except the 15-16 eyebrows and counters.
onboarding.input: Modal steps: SupportsKeyboardFocus true, root focus forwards to the primary action, pending focus is re-applied each tick, and focus that falls to SViewport/SWindow is restored while the front end and map are closed. Enter / Space / A press the focused button; arrows, D-pad, left stick and Tab / Shift+Tab step along the single wrapping button row; Esc, B, Virtual_Back and F2 skip on Welcome and close (AdvanceOnboarding) on Complete; Start activates the primary; every other key, mouse button and wheel is consumed. HUD steps: SupportsKeyboardFocus false and every input handler returns Unhandled, so play is never blocked.
onboarding.lifetime: RefreshStep rebuilds only when GetStep or GetKeys changed; body, progress and the extra hint read the component live through a weak controller pointer. After a modal rebuild the widget re-takes focus only when neither the front end nor the map is open.

increment_onboarding: Onboarding.Primary (Welcome 开始引导 / Complete 开始探索)
Onboarding.Skip (Welcome only; on Complete Esc/B closes via AdvanceOnboarding)

integration_notes: Add the widget with GameViewport->AddViewportWidgetContent so the engine DPI scale applies. Use FInputModeGameAndUI with SetWidgetToFocus(widget). The root forwards focus to the first action.
The controller should not also act on Esc/Start while the widget has focus. The widget consumes them and calls HandleBack itself.

The widget calls ANCPlayerController::StartOrResumeGame, ReturnToMainMenu, QuitToDesktop, CanContinueGame, GetFrontEndProgressText and IsFrontEndOpen, plus GetOnboarding, RestartOnboarding, SkipOnboarding and PreviewAudio for this increment, and nothing else on the controller.

SNCOnboarding calls only GetOnboarding, AdvanceOnboarding, SkipOnboarding, IsFrontEndOpen and IsMapOpen. It binds no delegates; the controller calls RefreshStep on OnStepChanged and owns visibility (HitTestInvisible during HUD steps, hidden during menus and the map), input mode, focus (FocusDefault on modal steps) and pause.
ANCHUD::DrawPause should not draw while the front end is open, so the two pause layers do not stack.
The source has UTF-8 Chinese literals in LOCTEXT. UBT compiles MSVC with UTF-8 source charset.
acceptance: Captures at 1280x720, 1600x900 and 1920x1080 show the same composition with the street and car readable on the right on title/pause.
Every tag is reachable by keyboard and by pad (D-pad and left stick) from its page default, without the mouse.
Arrow and D-pad presses move exactly one step. Esc/B never also toggles the controller pause.
A display change left unanswered reverts after 15 s while the world is paused. Keep persists across a restart.
Cancelling settings writes nothing. The GameUserSettings.ini timestamp is unchanged.
